rules: date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Do NOT send date in the request body.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: 2/4 ledger corrections completed; MVA posting and amount correction blocked by missing supplier reference
what_went_wrong: Voucher POSTs using account 2400 (leverandørgjeld) require a supplier reference, but the agent never looked up or included a supplier ID, causing repeated 422 errors for checks 3 and 4.
The MVA correction (account 4300/2710, 16750 kr) was never successfully posted — the agent attempted to use account 2400 as counterpart without a supplier, then gave up.
The amount correction for account 6300 (14600→11050) was only reversed but the corrective re-booking also failed due to the same missing supplier issue, leaving the correction incomplete.
Initial API calls had avoidable 4xx errors: missing dateFrom/dateTo params, duplicate 'postings' field, and invalid 'debitCreditType' field — all preventable with better endpoint knowledge.
what_worked: Successfully identified and reversed the duplicate voucher (bilag 28, account 7100, 5000 kr) using PUT /:reverse.
Successfully created correction voucher for wrong account (6300→7100, 7150 kr) via POST /ledger/voucher.
what_to_try_next: Before posting vouchers with account 2400, fetch the original voucher's supplier ID (GET /ledger/voucher/{id}?fields=*,postings(*,supplier(*))) and include it in the correction posting payload.
For the MVA correction, use the correct counterpart account (e.g., 4300 or the original expense account) instead of 2400, or fetch the supplier from the original voucher and include it.
Eliminate the 3 early 4xx errors by always including dateFrom/dateTo for voucher list calls, and validate field names against PostingDTO before using them in fields filters.
